summary: Phase C testing (iter 116) for OurRealm ORAi Game Studio — RPG/Racing/Farming/City Builder runtimes + Universal Editor quick actions. Backend pytest 6/6 PASS (test_phase_c_iter116.py): (1) GET /api/games returns exactly 11 published games; validation RPG e23dde50… does NOT leak into hub. (2) PATCH /api/admin/games/{id}/meta persists title/description/genre/labels/complexity, bumps version, appends versions[] snapshot. (3) POST /reroll-audio kind=music then sfx bumps version each time and stores spec.audio_variant_music / _sfx; bad kind=voice → 400. (4) GET /export returns {export,format:'ourrealm-game-v1'}; POST /import creates NEW approved game id with 'imported' label; cleanup via action=delete succeeds. (5) POST /versions/0/duplicate bumps version by 1. (6) All 5 new admin endpoints reject anon with 401/403. Frontend (stealth founder): CRITICAL BUG FOUND & FIXED — AdminGames.jsx used <GameQuickActions/> at line 610 without importing it; entire /admin/games?game=… detail crashed with 'GameQuickActions is not defined' red overlay. Added import → panel now renders. qa-edit-meta/qa-export/qa-import/qa-reroll-music/qa-reroll-sfx/qa-regen-cover all visible; qa-regen-cover NOT clicked. qa-edit-meta form opens with title='Emberbound Chronicles'; changed description and clicked qa-meta-save → 'Saved — new version created' toast. game-debug-panel renders 'Runtime ID: rpg · Template ID: tpl_rpg_v1 · Detected genre: RPG Adventure · Fallback used: NO'. Runtimes verified via /games?play=…: RPG (e23dde50…) — rpg-party-0 (Sproutle), rpg-quest, rpg-tile-x-y grid all render; player/creature/monster sprites shown; however clicking tile path (2,1)→(3,5) did NOT surface battle overlay (rpg-attack/rpg-creature-attack/rpg-catch/rpg-flee never appeared). Racing (465e7b15…) — rac-lap='Lap 1/3', rac-pos='Position 4/4', no crash after 10s. Farming (cd4e50c8…) — full loop works: coins 12→8 on plant (drop 4 ✓), water, 4×end-day (day 2→5), harvest, frm-sell-Wheat appears, sell 8→17 coins. Note: no [data-testid^=frm-plant-] chip surfaced (looks like plot click auto-plants Wheat instead of showing a picker) — non-blocking. City Builder (27a53ffb…) — cbl-gold/food/pop HUD all present; place Farm gold 60→46, place House 46→28, pop 0→4/20 after 8s ✓. Regression: /games hub loads (games-card-* testids visible), Neon Core Rush 5b171783… canvas renders 'Stage 1/12 · Score 0' and continues to run. Emberbound title left as 'Emberbound Chronicles' (unchanged, only description mutated during tests).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by test agent — <GameQuickActions/> used but not imported; entire /admin/games?game=<id> detail crashed with red 'GameQuickActions is not defined' overlay. Added `import GameQuickActions from '@/components/games/GameQuickActions'`.

integration_issues.issue: After stepping via click through path (2,1)→(3,5) toward the wild creature at (3,5), the battle overlay (rpg-attack/rpg-creature-attack/rpg-catch/rpg-flee) never appeared. HUD (rpg-party-0, rpg-quest, rpg-tile-x-y grid, sprites) all render correctly, but tile-click movement does not appear to step through / trigger a battle on encounter. May require keyboard input or the pathfinder skips battle tiles. Verify: does clicking a distant tile move step-by-step or teleport? Does battle fire only on keyboard-move?

action_items: Investigate RPG battle-trigger on tile-click movement — the four battle testids (rpg-attack, rpg-creature-attack, rpg-catch, rpg-flee) never rendered when the player was walked to the wild-creature tile via clicks. May be a movement/collision bug or expected only for keyboard controls.

(Optional) Surface the frm-plant-<Crop> picker chips per game-runtime spec — the Farming runtime currently auto-plants (Wheat) on plot click; the plant-menu chips advertised in the runtime spec were not observed in DOM.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminGames.jsx line 610 referenced <GameQuickActions/> without an import statement — a static-analysis/build-time check would have caught this (only surfaced at runtime as ReferenceError). Consider enabling eslint no-undef in CI for JSX components.

GameQuickActions.saveMeta always sends title+description+genre+labels+complexity even when unchanged; that's fine because backend accepts partial dict, but it always bumps the version even if the founder just re-clicked Save with no diff — could result in noisy versions[]. Consider client-side diff before PATCH.
reroll_audio picks a new variant with random.choice([v for v in range(1,12) if v != old]) — good uniqueness guarantee; spec.audio_variant_music/sfx are correctly persisted and observed.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (admin QA, Racing, Farming, City Builder, hub, Neon Core Rush all verified; RPG battle overlay not reachable via click-move)
